plain_text:
It's you
Doing things you're not supposed to do
You don't think that I would know the truth
But every day, I see the way you move
And it's not like you

I wanna think you love me, but you've never said the word
I gave you what you wanted and got nothing in return, oh

I don't love you, I don't hate you
I'm somewhere in the middle, somewhere in the middle
I don't love you, I don't have to
I'm losing it a little, somewhere in the middle

I just bought a hammer
I'm tryin' to fix you (fix you, but I know I can't)
But where are my manners?
I might have a screw loose (screw loose, oh)

Everything you say to me somehow turns me off
(You ruin everything, you ruin everything)
You told me it's okay to feel happy when you're gone
(You'll never get to me, you'll never get to me)

I don't love you, I don't hate you
I'm somewhere in the middle, somewhere in the middle
I don't love you, I don't have to
I'm losing it a little, somewhere in the middle

I'm doing more and talking less
I'm trying to learn to hold my breath
But everything just seems irrational
Getting over you is such an obstacle

(I don't love you) I don't love you, (I don't hate you) I don't hate you
(I'm somewhere) I'm somewhere in the middle (in the middle)
Somewhere in the middle
(I don't love you) I don't love you, (I don't have to) I don't hate to
(I'm losing) I'm losing it a little (it a little)
Somewhere in the middle
